sources.quote: Home - NSF I-Corps Hub Great Plains Skip to content About WHAT WE DO WHO WE ARE FAQ Programs Regional I-Corps National I-Corps Events Blog Resources About WHAT WE DO WHO WE ARE FAQ Programs Regional I-Corps National I-Corps Events Blog Resources invention to impact LEARN ABOUT I-CORPS TRANSFORMING INVENTION TO IMPACT The Great Plains I-Corps Hub provides immersive, entrepreneurial training for scientists, researchers, engineers and innovators alike. With emphasis on customer discovery, I-Corps is a free resource to help validate ideas and research, find market fit and build entrepreneurial ecosystems. WHAT IS I-CORPS? The National Science Foundation’s Innovation Corps (I-Corps™) program uses experiential education to help innovators gain valuable insight into entrepreneurship. WHAT IS I-CORPS APPLY FOR A COHORT Immerse yourself in an I-Corps cohort to gain the skills and knowledge needed to accelerate your innovation journey towards successful commercialization. APPLY FOR A COHORT GET INVOLVED Engage with the our ecosystem to access valuable networking opportunities that contribute to the growth and impact of the region’s thriving innovation community. GET INVOLVED IN A COHORT OUR PARTNERS "There is certainly value in learning more about the perspective of the customer, but that wasn't the greatest reward of the I-Corps program. I still benefit from the networking
